verdict: An invented model and a coat on a mannequin; the coat goes onto the same person with its colour, lapels and buttons, and she walks in it. Face, jeans and shoes hold through the clip. Two things to know: we asked for four gold buttons and got a double-breasted coat with eight, and the worn coat ends at the knee where the mannequin's reached mid-calf. The try-on stage uses a LoRA that is rent-only at its source, so treat this result as non-commercial.
peak_note: Peak is this run's own ComfyUI and tools, read from nvidia-smi every 2 seconds. The card was shared with other work. Time adds up each stage's own work, not the wait for the shared card.
